description: This file handles the saving of a folder in the InboundEmail module of SuiteCRM, either creating a new folder or updating an existing one, and then triggers a JavaScript-based refresh of the parent window.

classes.name: SugarFolder
classes.description: Represents a folder in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM inbound email system.

methods.name: setFolder
methods.description: Creates a new folder with the details provided in the request.

methods.name: updateFolder
methods.description: Updates an existing folder with the details provided in the request.
